unrealtrainmod.configuration.sortTranslu: Enabled by default. Disabling only skips vehicle translucent triangle sorting; depth calculation, index uploads and adjacent draw merging remain active. Ignored while static translucent batches are enabled. Applies to world and preview rendering. Overlapping translucent surfaces may blend incorrectly when disabled.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.useStaticTr: Disabled by default. Draws static translucent batches in submission order, skipping triangle collection, depth calculation, sorting and dynamic index uploads on the GPU path. Overrides translucent triangle sorting. Applies to world and preview rendering. Overlapping translucent surfaces may blend incorrectly.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.useVehicleI: Disabled by default for side-by-side comparison. Draws instanced vehicle CUTOUT batches with one indexed instanced draw per shared mesh range. Only CUTOUT requests are affected; MIXED, BLEND and CPU fallback keep their existing rules. Requires OpenGL 3.3 and the instanced model shader, otherwise the normal path is used automatically. Takes effect immediately without reloading models.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.logVehicleI: Disabled by default. Reports five-second windows per world or preview queue: draws, instances, submitted triangles, model counts, and CPU means and stage maxima for pose, scripts, queueing, opaque and translucent rendering. CPU scopes overlap and must not be added. Separately samples asynchronous GPU timeline spans for opaque and translucent passes, excluding intervening game rendering; these are not full-frame GPU times. Disabling stops statistics and releases queries at the next vehicle queue frame.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.useTrackRen: Disabled by default. Reuses render types, shader programs, samplers and fixed direction lights across world track draws. With material grouping enabled, batches sharing a material are drawn consecutively across meshes; otherwise submission order is preserved. Does not rebuild geometry or change the four-build/four-upload budgets. Takes effect on the next frame; previews and thumbnails keep their own state scopes.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.groupTrackD: Enabled by default, active with track render state reuse. Groups static world track batches by material; rigid turnout parts also group by shared mesh and owning chunk for instancing. Changes submission order between materials. Takes effect next frame without rebuilding fixed geometry or restarting animations. Previews and thumbnails are unchanged.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.turnoutAnim: Client display only. Full-stroke duration from 0 to 10 seconds, default 1. Zero switches immediately. Nonzero changes apply to the next throw. Reversing continues from the displayed position at the full-stroke speed. Pausing stops animation. Routes, occupancy and interlocking still switch immediately.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.logTrackRen: Disabled by default. Every five seconds, reports track draws, geometry, light checks, CPU timings, animated turnouts, JS calls/time, visible dynamic parts, and separate static, instance and active-buffer upload bytes. Nonblocking GPU sampling every 16 frames separates stationary and animation samples; builds, static uploads and empty frames are excluded, while streaming uploads stay in animation spans. GPU spans are not full-frame time. Missing samples show n/a. Disabling releases queries on the next track pass.
